# W144

> W144: a house of two agencies and three instruments. We study why one business holds and another breaks, and build the instruments that help yours hold.

W144 Company, a holding. A family house, not a startup. One team across five projects, since 2022. Alexander Zolotarynets, Founder; Serhii Zolotarynets, CEO; Mikhail Zolotarynets, Head of Engineering. 30+ people across all products.

The Academy of market power works like a laboratory: we study each niche, the cases that are not obvious and the people who buy, and only then put out a product we can stand behind.

## Software

- [w144.com](https://w144.com): Software for the decisions inside a business.
- Platform: Private commercial accounting. In development.
- The third instrument: A business online in five minutes. In development.

## Agencies

- [w144.eu](https://w144.eu): A company's position in the market, read on the market power map.
- [w144.dev](https://w144.dev): Intervening in a product's economics to raise what it earns.
